authority: Ohio Department of Agriculture and Ohio Laws

review.reviewMethod: Deterministic parsing of the complete contiguous sixty-three-row rule section followed by exact current-catalog binomial matching only.

contradictions.subject: complete-rule-list-versus-exact-catalog-matches
contradictions.priorState: The official rule designates sixty-three botanical rows as invasive plants.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Forty-five rows match current catalog binomials exactly; eighteen subspecies, variety, hybrid, misspelled, synonym, or unmatched rows do not.
contradictions.resolution: All sixty-three source rows are preserved. Forty-five exact matches are accepted and eighteen remain blocked for explicit taxonomy review.

contradictions.subject: expired-and-continuing-exceptions
contradictions.priorState: The rule text includes dated Callery pear and common privet exceptions plus continuing reed-canary-grass feed, controlled activity, research, education, and cultivar exceptions.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The dated Callery pear and common privet exceptions expired before the 2026-08-01 review date, while the other exceptions remain part of the rule context.
contradictions.resolution: Exact rule membership establishes regulated state applicability. The retained caveat preserves the continuing exceptions and does not create an unrestricted occurrence claim.

contradictions.subject: rule-membership-versus-occurrence
contradictions.priorState: Ohio designates the listed plants as invasive and restricts specified commerce and dissemination.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The rule contains no complete county occurrence survey or explicit negative evidence.
contradictions.resolution: Only state regulatory applicability is recorded. No county presence, absence, not-detected, or not-applicable claim is created.
